protocol: Continue the ten previously selected branches from the sixth path's last trough angle
input: Only the case identifier, cutoff h interval, and local complex position from each sealed trough row
formula: ODE w'=-H_b/(180 H_w); second-order Taylor advance using the current w' and w'' at every step, no root correction and no intermediate exact roots
baseline: One step is the local position, velocity and acceleration extrapolation
certificate: Independent forward interval continuation from the same cutoff; budget 4096 tested intervals per case, terminal disk radius 1e-30
arithmetic: 224-bit FLINT; only the symmetric Hurwitz family in the forward calculation
scoring: Seal every fixed-step prediction before interval continuation or querying Riemann zeros. Score absolute complex error against certified endpoint disk, then compare the disk with the ten Riemann zeros. No critical-line projection.
sampling: Retrospective test. The ten source branches were originally chosen by known destinations.
